name: agendador-junior
description: Agendamento em lote de vídeos curtos para Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels e TikTok

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json
